candidate_source_binding: the additive kernel, count-43 same-binary primitive, runtime receipts, tests, custody inputs, and this predeclaration must be committed and pushed together before the first candidate performance sample

scope.stage: count-matched primitive screen only; a pass authorizes opt-in production plumbing but is not an end-to-end acceptance
scope.target: Apple M4 Metal with a runtime-attested 32-lane SIMD width

production_call_mapping.qualification: source-derived mapping of the accepted boundary/tail decode lane; not a performance counter

arms.B: unchanged local accumulation and shared strides 128,64,32, followed by a redundant exact shuffle tail 16,8,4,2,1 in every 32-lane SIMDgroup

candidate_shape.tail_rule: all SIMD lanes execute each shuffle; only lanes below the stride perform the addition; every SIMDgroup loads the same partial[simd_lane] values and broadcasts its locally identical lane-zero result

unchanged_count43_aggregate_primitive_to.zero_timed_copy_qualification: zero explicit bridge memcpy inside the timed run, not zero GPU or shared-memory traffic
unchanged_count43_aggregate_primitive_to.qualification: count-matched aggregate mechanism screen, not the production submission topology; the accepted path distributes the 43 RMS calls over seven command buffers and 24 encoders

hypothesis.exactness_qualification: the source operand tree is intended to match exactly, but default Metal fast-math compilation does not make source-tree identity a language-level bitwise guarantee; target-binary to_bits evidence is mandatory

admission.primitive_harness_classification: always a non-formal diagnostic mechanism screen; it cannot promote or default a runtime path
admission.if_quiet_host_fails: complete the fixed schedule once only as explicitly non-formal diagnostic evidence

performance_continue_threshold.clearly_negative_block_definition: reject if either block has candidate latency improvement at or below -0.5 percent
performance_continue_threshold.result_if_passed: authorize additive opt-in production-profile plumbing and a separate predeclared end-to-end gate
performance_continue_threshold.result_if_failed: archive the fixed receipt and summary, then revert candidate implementation while retaining this predeclaration and the rejection evidence

fixed_fixture_and_schedule.generator: distinct deterministic xorshift64 streams encoded and hashed as little-endian f32 bits
fixed_fixture_and_schedule.warmup_block_1: ABBA with 64 consecutive count-43 calls per cell
fixed_fixture_and_schedule.warmup_block_2: BAAB with 64 consecutive count-43 calls per cell
fixed_fixture_and_schedule.timed_block_1: ABBA with 64 consecutive count-43 calls per cell
fixed_fixture_and_schedule.timed_block_2: BAAB with 64 consecutive count-43 calls per cell
fixed_fixture_and_schedule.timing: host monotonic elapsed time around one complete synchronous count-43 GPU call; fixture staging and full-chain correctness snapshots are outside the timed region
fixed_fixture_and_schedule.primary_statistic: even median of raw call latencies per arm within each block and pooled per arm
